<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jonathon and his dad were both born on $5 ^ \text{th}$ August.

Jonathon was born in $1985$ and his father is $32$ years older than him. 

In which year was his dad born?

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Hasan wakes up at the time shown below.

He needs to be at cricket training at $10 \ \text{am}$ - how many minutes does he have until his training starts?

![papers/aldenham-school/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q08-i00.png](/assets/papers/aldenham-school/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q08-i00.png "papers/aldenham-school/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q08-i00.png")

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The students on the Aldenham Geography trip to Iceland arrive at Heathrow Airport at $10{:}45$.

Their flight leaves at $13{:}05$.

How many minutes do they have to wait at the airport before their flight leaves?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The students on the Aldenham Geography trip to Iceland arrive at Heathrow Airport at $10{:}45$.
<emptyline>
Their flight leaves at $13{:}05$.
<emptyline>
How many minutes do they have to wait at the airport before their flight leaves?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Waiting Time}           &= 13{:}05 - 10{:}45 \\\\
                              &= 2 \ \text{hour} \ 20 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                              &= 2 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 20  \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                              &= 120 + 20  \\\\
                              &= 140  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$140  \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Given that Abbleshem is $170 \ \text{miles}$ away from Hocksworth, what was the average speed of my train?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Given that Abbleshem is $170 \ \text{miles}$ away from Hocksworth, what was the average speed of my train?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text {Speed} = \dfrac {\text{Distance}} {\text{Time}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Speed}    &= \dfrac {170 \ \text {miles}} {150 \ \text {minutes}} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac {170 \ \text {miles}} {\dfrac {150}{60} \ \text {hour}} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac {170 \times 60} {150} \ \text {miles/hour} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac {17 \times 10 \times 15 \times 4} {15 \times 10} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac {17 \times \cancel{10} \times \cancel{15} \times 4} {\cancel{15} \times \cancel{10}} \\\\
                 &= 17 \times 4 \\\\
                 &= 68 \ \text {miles/hour}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$68 \ \text {miles/hour}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The students on the Aldenham Football Tour to Madrid arrive at Heathrow Airport at $05{:}35$.

Their flight leaves at $08{:}10$.

How many minutes do they have to wait at the airport before their flight leaves?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The students on the Aldenham Football Tour to Madrid arrive at Heathrow Airport at $05{:}35$.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many minutes are there in three and a half hours?

-  $4$ 
-  $60$ 
-  $210$ 
-  $180.5$ 
-  $3600$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many minutes are there in three and a half hours?
<emptyline>
-  $4$ 
-  $60$ 
-  $210$ 
-  $180.5$ 
-  $3600$
</code></pre>

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \text{ hours} + 30 \text{ minutes} \\\\
&= 3 \times 60 \text{ minutes} + 30 \text{ minutes}\\\\
&= 180 + 30 \\\\
&= 210 \text{ minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

At what time will it finish?

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A coach left London Victoria $5 \ \text{minutes}$ late, at $13{:}45$, 
and arrived in Banbury $14 \ \text{minutes}$ early, at $17{:}05$. 
How long should the journey have taken if the coach had left and arrived on time?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A coach left London Victoria $5 \ \text{minutes}$ late, at $13{:}45$, 
and arrived in Banbury $14 \ \text{minutes}$ early, at $17{:}05$. 
How long should the journey have taken if the coach had left and arrived on time?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Original time to leave}    &= 13{:}45 - 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                  &= 13{:}40  \\\\
\text {Original time to arrive}   &= 17{:}05 + 14 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                  &= 17{:}19 \\\\
\text {Duration of journey}       &= 17{:}19 - 13{:}40 \\\\
                                  &= 3 \ \text {hours} \ 39 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3 \ \text {hours} \ 39 \ \text{minutes}$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Chris runs round a track at a speed of $6 \ \text{km/hour}$.

Dave runs round the same track at a speed of $9 \ \text{km/hour}$.

When Chris has run $18$ laps, how many laps has Dave run?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Chris runs round a track at a speed of $6 \ \text{km/hour}$.
<emptyline>
Dave runs round the same track at a speed of $9 \ \text{km/hour}$.
<emptyline>
When Chris has run $18$ laps, how many laps has Dave run?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Ratio of their speed}            &= \dfrac {9} {6} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 3} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 3} {\cancel{3} \times 2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
\text {Laps ran by Dave}                &= \dfrac {3} {2} \ \text {of} \ 18 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3} {2} \times 18 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 18} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
                                        &= 3 \times 9 \\\\
                                        &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Ratio of their speed}            &= \dfrac {9} {6} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 3} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 3} {\cancel{3} \times 2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
\text {Laps ran by Dave}                &= \dfrac {3} {2} \ \text {of} \ 18 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3} {2} \times 18 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 18} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
                                        &= 3 \times 9 \\\\
                                        &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**


Last week George spent $12 \ \text{hours}$ playing on his Xbox. 

He spent the same length of time on it each weekday and twice as long on it each day at the weekend. 

How long (in hours and minutes) did he send on his Xbox on Saturday?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">
Last week George spent $12 \ \text{hours}$ playing on his Xbox. 
<emptyline>
He spent the same length of time on it each weekday and twice as long on it each day at the weekend. 
<emptyline>
How long (in hours and minutes) did he send on his Xbox on Saturday?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the time spent playing each weekday $= a$

Time spent playing on weekend $= 2a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \times a + 2 \times 2a         &= 12  \\\\
5a + 4a                          &= 12 \\\\
9a                               &= 12 \\\\
a                                &= \dfrac {12} {9} \\\\
a                                &= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {3 \times 3} \\\\
a                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 4} {\cancel{3} \times 3} \\\\
a                                &= \dfrac {4} {3} \ \text {hours}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time spent on saturday}    &= 2a  \\\\
                                 &= 2 \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {8} {3} \\\\
                                 &= 2 \dfrac {2} {3} \ \text {hours} \\\\
                                 &= 2 \ \text {hours } 40 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2 \ \text {hours } 40 \ \text {minutes}$

</div>
</div>

$

**Question**

How many minutes are there from $11.11$ until $23.23$ on the same day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

\begin{aligned}
&= 23{:}23 - 11{:}11 \\\\
&= 12 \text{ hours} \ 12 \text{ minutes} \\\\
&= 12 \times 60 \text{ minutes} + 12\text{ minutes} \\\\
&= 720 + 12 \\\\
&= 732 \text { minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

Gemma had a baby born on $1 ^ \text{st}$ February $2017$.

On what date will the baby be $400$ days old?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Gemma had a baby born on $1 ^ \text{st}$ February $2017$.
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Date}     &= 1 \text{st February } 2017 + 400 \ \text{ days} \\\\
                &= 1 \text{st February } 2017 + 365 \ \text{ days} + 28 \ \text{ days} + 7 \ \text{ days}  \\\\
                &= 1 \text{st February } 2017 + 1 \  \text{year} + 1 \ \text{month} + 7 \ \text{ days}  \\\\
                &= 8 \text{th March } 2018
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

How many buses are needed to transport $175$ students to the athletics stadium?

**Question**

Mark goes to school from Monday to Friday, but he has trouble getting out 
of bed and arrives late if there is an **'s'** in the name of the day. 

During the $12$ weeks of term, how many days did he arrive late?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

of bed and arrives late if there is an **'s'** in the name of the day.

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Days with letter 's' are Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Count of days that have 's'}  &= 3 \\\\
\text {Days he arrive late }        &= 12 \times 3 \\\\
                                    &= 36
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cormac leaves the house with $\pounds 120$ in his wallet after his birthday.

He spends $25 \%$ of it on a game for his Xbox, and $10 \%$ of the rest on a DVD. 
How much money does he have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Cormac leaves the house with $\pounds 120$ in his wallet after his birthday.
<emptyline>
He spends $25 \%$ of it on a game for his Xbox, and $10 \%$ of the rest on a DVD. 
How much money does he have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent on Xbox} &= 25 \% \ \text {of } 120 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {25} {100} \times 120 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {25 \times 120} {100} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {25 \times 30 \times 4} {25 \times 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac { \cancel 25 \times 30 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 25 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                            &= \pounds  30 \\\\
\text {Money spent on DVD}  &= 10 \% \ \text {of } (120 - 90) \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 90 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 90} {100} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1\cancel{0} \times 9\cancel{0}} {1\cancel{0}\cancel{0}} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 9 \\\\
\text {Money left}          &= 120 - 30 - 9 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 71
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 72$

</div>

                            &= \dfrac {25 \times 30 \times 4} {25 \times 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac { \cancel 25 \times 30 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 25 \times \cancel 4} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A train left London at $11{:}30$ and arrived in Glasgow at $15{:}50$. 

The train only made $3$ stops, each lasting $5 \ \text{minutes}$.

For how many minutes was the train moving on this journey?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A train left London at $11{:}30$ and arrived in Glasgow at $15{:}50$. 
<emptyline>
The train only made $3$ stops, each lasting $5 \ \text{minutes}$.
<emptyline>
For how many minutes was the train moving on this journey?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time}  &= 15{:}50 - 11{:}30 - 5 \times 3 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 4 \ \text{hours} \ 20 \ \text{minutes} - 15 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 4 \ \text{hours} \ 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 4 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 240 + 5 \\\\
             &= 245 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$245 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

If August $5 ^ \text{th}$ falls on a Tuesday, on which day of the week will New
Year's Day fall next year?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If August $5 ^ \text{th}$ falls on a Tuesday, on which day of the week will New
Year's Day fall next year?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's calculate the total number of days from August $5^{\text{th}}$ to January $1^{\text{st}}$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Days left in August}  &= 31 - 5 = 26 \\\\
\text{September}            &= 30 \\\\
\text{October}              &= 31 \\\\
\text{November}             &= 30 \\\\
\text{December}             &= 31 \\\\
\text{January (up to } 1^{\text{st}} \text{)}             &= 1 \\\\
\text{Total days}           &= 26 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 1 \\\\
                            &= 149 \text{ days}
\end{aligned}
$

Lets calculate how many weeks and extra days are there in $149$ days.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of weeks}    &= 149 \div 7 \\\\
                            &= 21 \ \text{remainder} \ 2
\end{aligned}
$

This means that there are $21$ full weeks and $2$ extra days.

August $5 ^ \text{th}$ falls on a Tuesday and so January $1^{\text{st}}$ is Tuesday + $2$ days = Thursday.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Thursday

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Bus fares had increased by a tenth.
The price was previously $\pounds 4.50$ for a single trip between Salton and Pepperton.

Alice and her sisters paid together for their bus trip (under the new price system) with a $\pounds 20$ note.
How much change did they get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bus fares had increased by a tenth.

<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the fare increased by a tenth, then the fare will be $100 + 10 = 110 \%$ of the previous fare. Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {New Bus fare}        &= \dfrac {110} {100} \times 4.5 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {110 \times 4.5} {100} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 4.95 \\\\
\text {Change they got}     &= 20 - 3 \times 4.95 \\\\
                            &= 20 - 14.85 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5.15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 5.15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The lengths of four of the Henry Potter films are as follows:

| Henry Potter and the Philosopher's Loan  | $143 \ \text{minutes}$|
|:----------------------------------------:|:--------------:|
| Henry Potter and the Pizza of Azkaban    | $158 \ \text{minutes}$|
| Henry Potter and the Half Asleep Prince  | $144 \ \text{minutes}$|
| Henry Potter and the Dodgy Shadows       | $135 \ \text{minutes}$|

Find the total length of all four films, giving your answer in hours and minutes.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The lengths of four of the Henry Potter films are as follows:
<emptyline>
| Henry Potter and the Philosopher's Loan  | $143 \ \text{minutes}$|
|:----------------------------------------:|:--------------:|
| Henry Potter and the Pizza of Azkaban    | $158 \ \text{minutes}$|
| Henry Potter and the Half Asleep Prince  | $144 \ \text{minutes}$|
| Henry Potter and the Dodgy Shadows       | $135 \ \text{minutes}$|
<emptyline>
Find the total length of all four films, giving your answer in hours and minutes.
</code></pre>
</div>

\text{Total length} &= 143 + 158 + 144 + 135 \\\\
                    &= 580 \text { minutes} \\\\
                    &= 9 \text { hours } 40 \text { minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

Amee went out when she thought it was half past ten and she returned 
when she thought it was quarter to nine on the same morning (!). 

How many minutes was she really out for?

![papers/brentwood-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q11-i00.png](/assets/papers/brentwood-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q11-i00.png "papers/brentwood-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q11-i00.png")

Emily runs the same distance in a time of $13.762 \ \text{seconds}$.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I went to watch a three-hour concert but the music was so awful that I only stayed for $15 \%$ of it.
How many minutes did I stay at the concert for?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I went to watch a three-hour concert but the music was so awful that I only stayed for $15 \%$ of it.
How many minutes did I stay at the concert for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Minutes stayed}              &= 15 \% \ \text {of} \ 3 \ \text{hours} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {15} {100} \times 3 \times 60 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {15 \times 3 \times 60} {100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 \times 2 \times 10} {5 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 \times \cancel {2} \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {5} \times \cancel {2} \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 3 \times 3 \\\\
                                    &= 27 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27 \ \text {minutes}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $\text{minutes}$ are there between $9.23\ \text{am}$ and $1.06\ \text{pm}$? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $\text{minutes}$ are there between $9.23\ \text{am}$ and $1.06\ \text{pm}$? 
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 1{:}06 \ \text {pm} - 9{:}23 \ \text {am} \\\\
&= 3 \ \text {hours} \  43 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
&= 3 \times 60 \ \text {minutes} + 43 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
&= 180 + 43 \\\\
&= 223 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

He starts listenig at $1952$, what time does he finish?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                                        &= 20{:}06
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many seconds in $24 \ \text{hours}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many seconds in $24 \ \text{hours}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 24 \ \text{hours} \\\\
&=  24 \times 60 \times 60 \ \text{seconds} \\\\
&=  24 \times 3600 \\\\
&= 86400 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$86400  \ \text {seconds}$

</div>
</div>

&= 24 \ \text{hours} \\\\

\end{aligned}

**Question**

The sun rose at $05{:}43$ and set at $18{:}05$. How many minutes were there between sunrise and sunset?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>

                                                    &= 12 \ \text{hour} \ 22 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\

                                                    &= 720 + 22 \\\\
                                                    &= 742 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

The sun rose at $05{:}34$ and set at $21{:}15$. How many minutes were there between sunrise and sunset?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                            &= 6 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 25  \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                            &= 360 + 25 \\\\
                            &= 385  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A coach journey from Plymouth to Exeter leaves at $16.15$ and arrives at $17.36$. How many minutes does the journey take?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken}     &= 17{:}36 - 16{:}15 \\\\
                      &= 1 \ \text{hour} \ 21 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                      &= 1 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 21 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                      &= 60 + 21 \\\\
                      &= 81  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many seconds in a day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many seconds in a day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 1 \ \text{day} \\\\
&= 24 \ \text{hours} \\\\
&= 24 \times 60 \times 60 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
&= 24 \times 3600 \\\\
&= 86400 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$86400 \ \text {seconds}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A jumbo jet also leaves London at $22{:}45$ and takes a total of $11 \ \text{hours } 35 \ \text{minutes}$ to fly to Hong Kong. 
Hong Kong is $7 \ \text{hours}$ ahead of London (i.e., when the time is $13{:}00$ in London, it is $20{:}00$ in Hong Kong).

Work out what the local time is in Hong Kong when the flight lands. Give your answer in $24 \ \text{hour}$ format.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>
Work out what the local time is in Hong Kong when the flight lands. Give your answer in $24 \ \text{hour}$ format.
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

It is an $8 \ \text{minute}$ walk from John's house to Brixton station, 
and a $6 \ \text{minute}$ walk from West Dulwich to his form room at Dulwich College. 
Work out what time John will arrive at his form room if he leaves home at $0805$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">It is an $8 \ \text{minute}$ walk from John's house to Brixton station, 
and a $6 \ \text{minute}$ walk from West Dulwich to his form room at Dulwich College. 
Work out what time John will arrive at his form room if he leaves home at $0805$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Arrival Time at the station}     &= 08{:}05 +  8 \ \text{minutes}\\\\
                                       &= 08{:}13 
\end{aligned}
$

John will get on the next train at $08{:}16$.

The train reaches West Dulwich station at $08{:}21$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Arrival Time at his form room}     &= 08{:}21 +  6 \ \text{minutes}\\\\
                                         &= 08{:}27 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$08{:}27$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A different train travels from London to Edinburgh at constant speed. The journey takes $3 \ \text{hours}$ and $30 \ \text{minutes}$ 
and the distance travelled is $420 \ \text{miles}$. Calculate the speed of the train.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A different train travels from London to Edinburgh at constant speed. The journey takes $3 \ \text{hours}$ and $30 \ \text{minutes}$ 
and the distance travelled is $420 \ \text{miles}$. Calculate the speed of the train.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text {Speed} = \dfrac {\text{Distance}} {\text{Time}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Time} &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 30 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 3.5 \ \text{hours} \\\\
\text {Speed} &= \dfrac{420 \ \text {miles}} {3.5 \ \text{hours}} \\\\
              &= \dfrac{420 \times 2} {3.5 \times 2} \\\\
              &= \dfrac{420 \times 2} {7} \\\\
              &= \dfrac{7 \times 60 \times 2} {7} \\\\
              &= \dfrac{\cancel{7} \times 60 \times 2} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
              &= 60 \times 2 \\\\
              &= 120 \text{ miles/hour}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$120 \text{ miles/hour}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Train start at station $A$ at $10{:}45 \ \text{am}$ and reaches station $B$ at $13{:}20$. If it stops for $10 \ \text{mins}$ 
in between. How much is the travel time from station $A$ to $B$ if it doesn't stop in between.

-  $2 \ \text{h} \ 25 \ \text{mins}$
-  $3 \ \text{h} \ 40 \ \text{mins}$
-  $2 \ \text{h} \ 35 \ \text{mins}$
-  $4 \ \text{h} \ 20 \ \text{mins}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many hours were there in the year $2011?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many hours were there in the year $2011?$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The year $2011$ is not a leap year, so there are $365$ days.

$1 \ \text {day} = 24 \ \text {hrs}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Hours in year 2011}    &= 365 \ \text {days} \times 24 \ \text {hrs} \\\\
                              &= 8760 \ \text {hrs}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A programme starts at $9{:}15 \ \text{pm}$ and ends at $11{:}06 \ \text{pm}$.
How many minutes did it last? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A programme starts at $9{:}15 \ \text{pm}$ and ends at $11{:}06 \ \text{pm}$.
How many minutes did it last? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Duration} &= 11{:}06 \ \text{pm} - 9{:}15 \ \text{pm} \\\\
                &= 1 \ \text {hour} \ 51 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                &= 1 \times 60 \ \text {minutes} + 51 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                &= 60 + 51 \\\\
                &= 111 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$111 \ \text {minutes}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Prasha is swimming lengths at her local swimming pool.

She takes $24 \ \text{seconds}$ to swim a length doing front crawl.

She takes $60 \ \text{seconds}$ to swim a length doing breaststroke.

She swims $3$ lengths of each (so a total of $6$ lengths).

The last length takes an extra $6 \ \text{seconds}$ as she gets tired.

How long did she take to swim all $6$ lengths? Give your answer in minutes and seconds. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Prasha is swimming lengths at her local swimming pool.
<emptyline>
She takes $24 \ \text{seconds}$ to swim a length doing front crawl.
<emptyline>
She takes $60 \ \text{seconds}$ to swim a length doing breaststroke.
<emptyline>
She swims $3$ lengths of each (so a total of $6$ lengths).
<emptyline>
The last length takes an extra $6 \ \text{seconds}$ as she gets tired.
<emptyline>
How long did she take to swim all $6$ lengths? Give your answer in minutes and seconds. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total time} &= 3 \times 24 + 3 \times 60 + 6 \\\\
                   &= 72 + 180 + 6 \\\\
                   &= 258 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
                   &= 4 \ \text {minutes} \ 18 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Gina finished her homework at $8{:}24 \ \text{pm}$ having started at $6{:}52 \ \text{pm}$.
How many minutes did she spend on it?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Gina finished her homework at $8{:}24 \ \text{pm}$ having started at $6{:}52 \ \text{pm}$.
How many minutes did she spend on it?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time spent}          &= 8{:}24 \ \text{pm} - 6{:}52 \ \text{pm} \\\\
                              &= 1 \ \text{hour} \ 32 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                              &= 1 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 32  \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                              &= 60 + 32 \\\\
                              &= 92 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$92 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kitty's favourite Saturday night TV programme , The *Y Multiple*, was due to begin at $8{:}50 \ \text{pm}$ and it last $2 \dfrac{1}{4} \ \text{hours}$.

Last Saturday it started $13 \ \text{minutes}$ late.  What time did it finish? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Kitty's favourite Saturday night TV programme , The *Y Multiple*, was due to begin at $8{:}50 \ \text{pm}$ and it last $2 \dfrac{1}{4} \ \text{hours}$.
<emptyline>
Last Saturday it started $13 \ \text{minutes}$ late.  What time did it finish? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Finish time} &= 8{:}50 \ \text{pm} + 2 \dfrac{1} {4} \ \text {hours} + 13 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                    &= 8{:}50 \ \text{pm} + 2 \ \text {hours} \ 15 \ \text {minutes} + 13 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                    &= 8{:}50 \ \text{pm} + 2 \ \text {hours} \ 28 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                    &= 11{:}18 \ \text {pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many seconds are there in one week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many seconds are there in one week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text {min}     &= 60 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
1 \ \text {hr}      &= 60 \times 60 \\\\
                    &= 3600 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
1 \ \text {day}     &= 24 \times 3600 \\\\
                    &= 86400 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
1 \ \text {week}    &= 7 \times 86400 \\\\
                    &= 604800 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Buses leave Halifax to Elland every $9 \ \text{minutes}$. Buses leave Halifax to Sowerby Bridge every $12 \ \text{minutes}$. 
A bus to Elland and a bus to Sowerby Bridge both leave Halifax at $9 \ \text{am}$. At what time will a bus to Elland and a bus to Sowerby Bridge next leave Halifax at the same time?

- $10.12 \ \text{am}$
- $09.27 \ \text{am}$
- $10.48 \ \text{am}$
- $09.36 \ \text{am}$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Buses leave Halifax to Elland every $9 \ \text{minutes}$. Buses leave Halifax to Sowerby Bridge every $12 \ \text{minutes}$. 
A bus to Elland and a bus to Sowerby Bridge both leave Halifax at $9 \ \text{am}$. At what time will a bus to Elland and a bus to Sowerby Bridge next leave Halifax at the same time?
<emptyline>
- $10.12 \ \text{am}$
- $09.27 \ \text{am}$
- $10.48 \ \text{am}$
- $09.36 \ \text{am}$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Time at which both buses leave together again} &= 09.00 \ \text{am} + \text {Lowest common multiple of the time intervals} \\\\
                                                      &= 09.00 \ \text{am} + \text {Lowest common multiple of} \ 9 \ \text{and} \ 12 \\\\
                                                      &= 09.00 \ \text{am} + 36 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                      &= 09.36 \ \text{am}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

How long, in minutes, does it take the $11 \ 30$ to get from London to Peterborough? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken}           &= 12{:}35 - 11{:}30 \\\\
                            &= 1 \ \text{hour} \ 5 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                            &= 1 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 5  \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                            &= 60 + 5  \\\\
                            &= 65  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$65  \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

She wakes up every morning at $7 \ \text{am}$.

Use the rule to work out what time she needs to go to sleep.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate how many seconds there are in $15 \dfrac{1}{2}$ hours.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate how many seconds there are in $15 \dfrac{1}{2}$ hours.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 15 \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31} {2} \ \text {hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31} {2} \times 60 \times 60 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31 \times 60 \times 60} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31 \times 60 \times 30 \times 2} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {31 \times 60 \times 30 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
&= 31 \times 60 \times 30 \\\\
&= 55800 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$55800 \ \text {seconds}$

</div>

**Question**

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How long does the $0548$ from Winnersh take to reach London Waterloo?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How long does the $0548$ from Winnersh take to reach London Waterloo?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{ Time taken }           &= 07{:}07 - 05{:}48 \\\\
                              &= 1 \ \text{hour} \ 19 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                              &= 1 \times 60 + 19  \ \text{minutes} \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The timetable shows the times of $3$ trains travelling from Birmingham to Leicester in the afternoon.

**Birmingham New Street-Nuneaton-Narborough-Leicester**

|                           |  *Train $1$*     |  *Train $2$*    |  *Train $3$*    |
|-----------------------    |:-----------:     |:----------:     |:----------:     |
| Birmingham New Street     | $16\quad 03$     | $16\quad20$     | $17\quad07$     |
| Nuneaton                  | $16\quad 30$     | $16\quad58$     | $17\quad36$     |
| Narborough                | $16\quad 45$     | $17\quad11$     | $17\quad50$     |
| Leicester                 | $16\quad56$      | $17\quad25$     | $18\quad03$     |

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>
|                           |  *Train $1$*     |  *Train $2$*    |  *Train $3$*    |
|-----------------------    |:-----------:     |:----------:     |:----------:     |
| Birmingham New Street     | $16\quad 03$     | $16\quad20$     | $17\quad07$     |
| Nuneaton                  | $16\quad 30$     | $16\quad58$     | $17\quad36$     |
| Narborough                | $16\quad 45$     | $17\quad11$     | $17\quad50$     |
| Leicester                 | $16\quad56$      | $17\quad25$     | $18\quad03$     |
</code></pre>
</div>




<ul class="subquestion lower-alpha question_type_subquestion list_type_lower-alpha">
<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which train is the slowest?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which train is the slowest?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken by Train 1}  &= 16{:}56 - 16{:}03 \\\\
                              &= 53 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken by Train 2}  &= 17{:}25 - 16{:}20 \\\\
                              &= 1 \ \text{hour} \ 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                              &= 1 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                              &= 60 + 5 \\\\
                              &= 65 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken by Train 3}  &= 18{:}03 - 17{:}07 \\\\
                              &= 56 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

$\text {Train 2 is slowest}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Train 2

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

**Question**

*Ten green bottles hanging on a wall*

*Ten green bottles hanging on a wall*

*If one green bottle should accidentally fall,* 

*There'd be nine green bottles hanging on the wall*

*Nine green bottles...*

intervals, at what time would the last bottle fall?

</div>

<emptyline>

<emptyline>
*If one green bottle should accidentally fall,* 
<emptyline>
*There'd be nine green bottles hanging on the wall*
<emptyline>
*Nine green bottles...*
<emptyline>
If the first bottle fell at ten past five in the morning $(5.10 \ \text{am})$ and the others fell down at five minute 
intervals, at what time would the last bottle fall?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Last bottle falls at} &= 5{:}10  + 9 \times 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                           &= 5{:}10  + 45 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                           &= 5{:}55 \ \text{am}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A child's heart beats $80 \ \text{times per minute}$. How many times will it beat between $05{:}30$ and $15{:}30$ on the same day.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A child's heart beats $80 \ \text{times per minute}$. How many times will it beat between $05{:}30$ and $15{:}30$ on the same day.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Times in minutes}                &= 15{:}30 - 05{:}30 \\\\
                                      &=  10 \ \text {hours} \\\\
                                      &= 10 \times 60 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                                      &= 600 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
\text {Number of times heart beats}   &= 80 \times 600 \\\\
                                      &= 48000 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48000$

</div>
</div>

FINISH $17{:}25$

For how long was the video recording? 

</div>

**Question**

What is $463 \ \text{minutes}$ in hours and minutes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$2008$ is a leap year, and this year the $29 ^\text{th}$ of February falls on a Friday. On what day of the week will the $29 ^\text{th}$ of February fall in the next leap year  $(2012)?$ (Remember there are $366 \ \text{days}$ in a leap year).

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$2008$ is a leap year, and this year the $29 ^\text{th}$ of February falls on a Friday. On what day of the week will the $29 ^\text{th}$ of February fall in the next leap year  $(2012)?$ (Remember there are $366 \ \text{days}$ in a leap year).
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&=  \text {Friday} + \dfrac {366+365+365+365} {7} \ \text{weeks}\\\\
&=  \text {Friday} + \dfrac {1461} {7} \ \text{weeks}\\\\
&= \text{Friday} + 208 \ \text{weeks} + \dfrac {5} {7} \ \text{weeks} \\\\
&= \text{Friday} + 5 \ \text{days} \\\\
&=\text {Wednesday}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text {Wednesday}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A boy has to be in school by $8.35 \ \text{am}$. It takes him $25 \ \text{minutes}$ to get washed and dressed, $15 \ \text{minutes}$ to eat breakfast and then $18 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk to school. What is the latest time that he should get out of bed?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A boy has to be in school by $8.35 \ \text{am}$. It takes him $25 \ \text{minutes}$ to get washed and dressed, $15 \ \text{minutes}$ to eat breakfast and then $18 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk to school. What is the latest time that he should get out of bed?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time}  &= 8{:}35  \ \text{am} - 25 \ \text{minutes} - 15 \ \text{minutes} - 18 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 8{:}35  \ \text{am} - 58 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
             &= 7{:}37 \ \text{am}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7{:}37 \ \text{am}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

You have to catch the bus after school. Buses leave school at $15.55$ and $16.35$. If you are $4 \ \text{minutes}$ late for the first bus, how long do you have to wait for the second bus?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">You have to catch the bus after school. Buses leave school at $15.55$ and $16.35$. If you are $4 \ \text{minutes}$ late for the first bus, how long do you have to wait for the second bus?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Arrival time} &= 15{:}55 + 4 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                    &= 15{:}59 \\\\
\text{Waiting time} &= 16{:}35 - 15{:}59 \\\\
                    &= 36 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$36 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Antony is making some cupcakes. It takes him $20 \ \text{minutes}$ to prepare the ingredients, the cakes take $22 \ \text{minutes}$ to bake and 
he needs to leave them for $10 \ \text{minutes}$ to cool down. If he wants to eat them at $4{:}10 \ \text{pm}$, what time should he start preparing the ingredients?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Antony is making some cupcakes. It takes him $20 \ \text{minutes}$ to prepare the ingredients, the cakes take $22 \ \text{minutes}$ to bake and 
he needs to leave them for $10 \ \text{minutes}$ to cool down. If he wants to eat them at $4{:}10 \ \text{pm}$, what time should he start preparing the ingredients?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Start time}               &= 4{:}10 \ \text{pm}  - 20 \ \text{minutes} - 22 \ \text{minutes} - 10 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                &= 4{:}10 \ \text{pm} - 52 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                &= 3{:}18 \ \text{pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3{:}18 \ \text{pm}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract the number of $\text{hours}$ in a day from the number of $\text{seconds}$ in a $\text{minute}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract the number of $\text{hours}$ in a day from the number of $\text{seconds}$ in a $\text{minute}$.
</code></pre>

&= 36

$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tasweer is making some cupcakes. It takes her $15 \ \text{minutes}$ to prepare the ingredients, the cakes take $18 \ \text{minutes}$ to bake and she needs to leave them for $10 \ \text{minutes}$ to cool down. If she wants to eat them at $3{:}15 \ \text{pm}$, what time should she start preparing the ingredients? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tasweer is making some cupcakes. It takes her $15 \ \text{minutes}$ to prepare the ingredients, the cakes take $18 \ \text{minutes}$ to bake and she needs to leave them for $10 \ \text{minutes}$ to cool down. If she wants to eat them at $3{:}15 \ \text{pm}$, what time should she start preparing the ingredients? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Start time}                                           &= 3{:}15 \ \text{pm} - 15 \ \text{minutes} - 18 \ \text{minutes} - 10 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                            &= 3{:}15 \ \text{pm} - 43 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                            &= 2{:}32 \ \text{pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$2{:}32 \ \text{pm}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many minutes are there in one day? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many minutes are there in one day? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 1 \ \text{day} \\\\
&= 1 \times 24 \ \text{hours} \\\\
&= 24 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
&= 1440 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1440 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Josh has to be at work at $8{:}15 \ \text{am}$. It takes him $15 \ \text{minutes}$ to get dressed, $20 \ \text{minutes}$ to eat breakfast and $12 \ \text{minutes}$ to drive to work. What is the latest time Josh could get up to get to work on time?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Josh has to be at work at $8{:}15 \ \text{am}$. It takes him $15 \ \text{minutes}$ to get dressed, $20 \ \text{minutes}$ to eat breakfast and $12 \ \text{minutes}$ to drive to work. What is the latest time Josh could get up to get to work on time?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Get up time}                                                     &= 8{:}15 - (15 + 20 + 12) \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                                       &= 8{:}15 - 47 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                                       &= 7{:}28 \ \text{am}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7{:}28 \ \text{am}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ann went to the cinema. The film started at $11{:}55 \ \text{AM}$ and lasted $117 \ \text{minutes}$. What time did the film end?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ann went to the cinema. The film started at $11{:}55 \ \text{AM}$ and lasted $117 \ \text{minutes}$. What time did the film end?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
