%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{End time}     &= 11{:}55 \ \text{am} + 117 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                    &= 11{:}55 \ \text{am} + 1 \ \text {hour} \ 57 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                    &= 01{:}52 \ \text {pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$01{:}52 \ \text {pm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

My train was scheduled to leave at $17{:}40$ and to arrive at $18{:}20$. However it started $5  \ \text{minutes}$ late and the journey then took $42  \ \text{minutes}$. At what time did I arrive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>
</div>

\text{Arrival Time}     &= 17{:}40 + 5 \ \text{minutes} + 42 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                        &= 17{:}40 + 47 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                        &= 18{:}27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many seconds are there in $\dfrac {1} {4}$ of $\dfrac {1} {6}$ of $\dfrac {1} {8}$ of a day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many seconds are there in $\dfrac {1} {4}$ of $\dfrac {1} {6}$ of $\dfrac {1} {8}$ of a day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text {of} \ \dfrac {1} {6} \ \text {of} \ \dfrac {1} {8} \ \text {of} \ 1 \ \text {day} \\\\ 
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {1} {6} \times \dfrac {1} {8} \times 24 \ \text {hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times  \dfrac {1} {6} \times  \dfrac {1} {8} \times 24 \times 60 \times 60  \ \text {seconds}\\\\\
&= \dfrac {24 \times 60 \times 60} {4 \times 6 \times 8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 4 \times 15 \times 6 \times 10} {4 \times 6 \times 8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 3 \times \cancel {4} \times 15 \times \cancel {6} \times 10} {\cancel {4} \times \cancel {6} \times \cancel {8}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 15 \times 10 \\\\
&= 45 \times 10 \\\\
&= 450 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$450 \ \text {seconds}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text {of} \ \dfrac {1} {6} \ \text {of} \ \dfrac {1} {8} \ \text {of} \ 1 \ \text {day} \\\\ 
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {1} {6} \times \dfrac {1} {8} \times 24 \ \text {hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {4} \times  \dfrac {1} {6} \times  \dfrac {1} {8} \times 24 \times 60 \times 60  \ \text {seconds}\\\\\
&= \dfrac {24 \times 60 \times 60} {4 \times 6 \times 8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 4 \times 15 \times 6 \times 10} {4 \times 6 \times 8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 3 \times \cancel {4} \times 15 \times \cancel {6} \times 10} {\cancel {4} \times \cancel {6} \times \cancel {8}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 15 \times 10 \\\\
&= 45 \times 10 \\\\
&= 450 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many minutes are there from $11{:}11$ until $23{:}23$ on the same day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many minutes are there from $11{:}11$ until $23{:}23$ on the same day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 23{:}23 - 11{:}11 \\\\
&= 12 \ \text{hours} \ 12 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
&= 12 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 12 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
&= 720 + 12 \\\\
&= 732 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $329$ days until my birthday. How many weeks is this? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $329$ days until my birthday. How many weeks is this? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Weeks until birthday} &= 329 \ \text{days} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {329} {7} \ \text {weeks}\\\\
                            &= \dfrac {7 \times 47 } {7} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 47 } {\cancel 7} \\\\
                            &=47 \ \text {weeks}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$47 \ \text {weeks}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A train leaves Solihull at $6.35 \ \text{am}$ and arrives at Liverpool at $10.22 \ \text{am}$. How many minutes does it take? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A train leaves Solihull at $6.35 \ \text{am}$ and arrives at Liverpool at $10.22 \ \text{am}$. How many minutes does it take? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken}     &= 10{:}22 \ \text{am} - 6{:}35 \ \text{am} \\\\
                      &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 47 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                      &= 3 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 47 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                      &= 180 + 47 \\\\
                      &= 227  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$227  \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jacqueline needs to catch a flight early tomorrow morning. She needs to get out of bed at $3.15 \ \text{am}$, but wants to make sure that she has at least $7\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{hours}$ of sleep. What is the
                                
latest time that Jacqueline can go to sleep this evening? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jacqueline needs to catch a flight early tomorrow morning. She needs to get out of bed at $3.15 \ \text{am}$, but wants to make sure that she has at least $7\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{hours}$ of sleep. What is the
<emptyline>
latest time that Jacqueline can go to sleep this evening? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Latest time}                     &= 3{:}15 \ \text{am} - 7\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {hours} \\\\
                                        &= 3{:}15 \ \text{am} - 7 \ \text {hours} \ 30 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                        &= 8{:}46 \ \text{pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

![papers/st-anselms-college/2018/sample-paper-3/s01-q07-s02-i00.png](/assets/papers/st-anselms-college/2018/sample-paper-3/s01-q07-s02-i00.png "papers/st-anselms-college/2018/sample-paper-3/s01-q07-s02-i00.png")

How many minutes will it be before the next time the hours and minutes are both multiples of $6 \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The next hour multiple of $6$ is $12$.

The next minute multiple of $6$ after $58$ is $60$, meaning $00$ of the next hour.

So the next valid time is $12{:}00$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Minutes}  &= 12{:}00 - 11{:}58 \\\\
                &= 2 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$2 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

**Question**

I need to catch a train from Birkenhead Park to arrive at Meols by $9.00$. What time train should I catch? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Meols times are: $8.28$ and $8.58$

We choose the latest train that still arrives on time. So we should catch the $8.44$ train from Birkenhead Park, arriving Meols at $8.58$.

Answer $= 8{.}44$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I start watching a film at $7{:}45 \ \text{pm}$ and turn the television off at $9{:}35 \ \text{pm}$. For how long was I watching television?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I start watching a film at $7{:}45 \ \text{pm}$ and turn the television off at $9{:}35 \ \text{pm}$. For how long was I watching television?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Watching Time} &= 9{:}35 - 7{:}45\\\\
                     &= 1 \ \text{hour} \ 50 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                     &= 1 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 50  \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                     &= 60 + 50 \\\\
                     &= 110  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If he is paid $\pounds 6.00$ for each hour worked, how much will he be paid for all the work?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If he is paid $\pounds 6.00$ for each hour worked, how much will he be paid for all the work?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total amount} &= 4 \ \text{hours} \ 15 \ \text{ minutes} \times 6 \\\\
                     &= (4 \ \text{hours} +   15 \ \text{ minutes} ) \times 6 \\\\
                     &= (4 \ \text{hours} +   \dfrac {15} {60} \ \text{hours} ) \times 6 \\\\
                     &= 4 \times 6 + \dfrac {15 \times 6} {60} \\\\
                     &= 24 + \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 6} {5 \times 2 \times 6} \\\\
                     &= 24 + \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 3 \times \cancel 6} {\cancel 5 \times 2 \times \cancel 6} \\\\
                     &= 24 + \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
                     &= 24 + 1.5 \\\\ 
                     &= \pounds 25.5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A child's heart beats $80 \ \text{times per minute}$. How many times will it beat between $8{:}30\ \text{am}$ and $3{:}30\ \text{pm}$ on the same day? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A child's heart beats $80 \ \text{times per minute}$. How many times will it beat between $8{:}30\ \text{am}$ and $3{:}30\ \text{pm}$ on the same day? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total time}       &= 3 {:} 30 \ \text {pm} - 8 {:} 30 \ \text {am}\\\\
                         &= 7 \ \text {hours} \\\\
                         &= 7 \times 60 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                         &= 420 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
\text {Heartbeat count}  &= 80 \times 420 \\\\
                         &= 33600
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$33600$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What time does the watch show when the correct time is $12$ noon on Friday, assuming the watch has not been reset again?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What time does the watch show when the correct time is $12$ noon on Friday, assuming the watch has not been reset again?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time Gained}     &= 48 \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {16 \times 3 \times 4} {3} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {16 \times \cancel 3 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                       &= 16 \times 4 \\\\
                       &= 64 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time shown}      &= \text{Actual time} + \text{Time gained} \\\\
                       &= 12{:}00 \ \text{pm} +64 \ \text{minutes}\\\\
                       &= 01{:}04 \ \text{pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$01{:}04 \ \text{pm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The watch is reset again to show the correct time at $12$ noon on Friday. 
What is the correct time when the watch is showing $19{:}40$ on Friday night?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The watch is reset again to show the correct time at $12$ noon on Friday. 
What is the correct time when the watch is showing $19{:}40$ on Friday night?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the time passed since 12 noon = a

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time shown}    &= \text{Correct time} + \text{Time gained} \\\\
19{:}40  &= (12{:}00 + a) + (a) \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
19{:}40  &=  12{:}00 +  a \times \dfrac{7} {3} \\\\
a        &= ( 19{:}40 - 12{:}00 ) \times \dfrac {3} {7} \\\\
a        &= (07 {:} 40) \times \dfrac {3} {7} \\\\
a        &= 03{:}17
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Correct time}    &=  12{:}00 \ \text{pm} + 03{:}17 \\\\
                       &=  15{:}07
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15{:}07 $

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the time passed since 12 noon = a
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time shown}    &= \text{Correct time} + \text{Time gained} \\\\
19{:}40  &= (12{:}00 + a) + (a) \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
19{:}40  &=  12{:}00 +  a \times \dfrac{7} {3} \\\\
a        &= ( 19{:}40 - 12{:}00 ) \times \dfrac {3} {7} \\\\
a        &= (07 {:} 40) \times \dfrac {3} {7} \\\\
a        &= 03{:}17
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Correct time}    &=  12{:}00 \ \text{pm} + 03{:}17 \\\\
                       &=  15{:}07
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Abigail gets up at $07{:}40$ in the morning. 

$25 \ \text{minutes}$ later she starts her breakfast, which takes $10 \ \text{minutes}$ to finish. 

She then leaves for school.  Her journey takes $35 \ \text{minutes}$ in total. 

She arrives $5 \ \text{minutes}$ late for registration. 

At what time is registration?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>

                              &= 8{:}05 \ \text{am} + 10 \ \text{minutes} + 35 \ \text{minutes} - 5 \ \text{minutes} \\\\

**Question**

How long will it take for the clock to show the correct time?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken to show correct time}  &= \dfrac{Time lag}{Time gain every hour} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{18 \times 60} {7 \dfrac{1}{2}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{18 \times 60}{\dfrac{15}{2}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{18 \times 60 \times 2}{15} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{18 \times 15 \times 4 \times 2}{15} \\\\
                                        &= 18 \times 4 \times 2 \\\\
\text{Time taken to show correct time}  &= 144 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                        &= \dfrac{18 \times 15 \times 4 \times 2}{15} \\\\
                                        &= 18 \times 4 \times 2 \\\\
\text{Time taken to show correct time}  &= 144 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Another clock is $30 \ \text{minutes}$ fast, but is losing $11 \dfrac{1}{4} \ \text{seconds per hour}$.

How many minutes fast will the second clock be when the first clock shows the right time?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Another clock is $30 \ \text{minutes}$ fast, but is losing $11 \dfrac{1}{4} \ \text{seconds per hour}$.
<emptyline>
How many minutes fast will the second clock be when the first clock shows the right time?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken to show correct time}  &= \dfrac{Time fast}{Time loss every hour} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{30 \times 60} {11 \dfrac{1}{4}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{30 \times 60}{\dfrac{45}{4}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{30 \times 60 \times 4}{45} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{3 \times 10 \times 15 \times 4 \times 4}{3 \times 15} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 10 \times \cancel{15} \times 4 \times 4}{\cancel{3} \times \cancel{15}} \\\\
                                        &= 10 \times 4 \times 4 \\\\
\text{Time taken to show correct time}  &= 160 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$

Time difference between first and second clock = $160 - 144 \ \text{hours}$
                                               = $16 \ \text{hours}$
</div>

having been delayed by $45 \ \text{minutes}$. At what time did it leave York?

</div>

- $3600$
- $1400$
- $1440$
- $51{,}840$
- $86{,}400$

**Question**

Tom goes to a theme park.

There are $4$ activities at the theme park.

The table gives information about these activities.

|   **Activity**   |         **Start times**        | **Time taken by activity (minutes)** |
|:----------------:|:------------------------------:|:------------------------------------:|
|  Penguin feeding | $10{:}45 \ 12{:}15 \ 13{:}45$  |                 $35$                  |
|    Jeep safari   | $10{:}45 \ 12{:}15 \ 13{:}45$  |                  $45$                  |
| Steam train ride | $10{:}45 \ 12{:}15 \ 13{:}45$  |                  $25$                  |
|   Dolphin show   | $10{:}45 \ 12{:}15 \ 13{:}45$  |                  $40$                  |

Tom wants to do all $4$ activities.

He arrives at the theme park at $10{:}20$. 

He needs to leave the theme park by $14{:}30$.

Plan a schedule for Tom's visit to the theme park so he can do all $4$ activities.

</div>

**Question**

How many days are there in $48 \ \text{weeks}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John decides to phone his Great Aunt Matilda at $2300 \ \text{hours}$ UK time on the $30 ^ \text{th}$ January. 
What is the time and date in Sydney when Matilda receives the call?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John decides to phone his Great Aunt Matilda at $2300 \ \text{hours}$ UK time on the $30 ^ \text{th}$ January. 
What is the time and date in Sydney when Matilda receives the call?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

                            &= 10{:}00
\end{aligned}

Matilda receives the call in Australia at $10{:}00$ on $31 ^ \text{st}$ January.

**Question**

John's sister Penny goes one better and decides to visit Great Aunt Matilda. 
She leaves the UK at the same time that John makes his phone call. Given that the total journey time is $27 \ \text{hours}$,
 what is the Sydney time and date when Penny arrives?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John's sister Penny goes one better and decides to visit Great Aunt Matilda. 
She leaves the UK at the same time that John makes his phone call. Given that the total journey time is $27 \ \text{hours}$,
 what is the Sydney time and date when Penny arrives?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Arrival time}       &= 23{:}00 + 27 \ \text {hours} + 11 \ \text {hours} \\\\
                          &= 23{:}00 + 38 \ \text {hours} \\\\
                          & = 13{:}00 \text{ on } 1 ^ \text{st} \text{ February}
\end{aligned}
$

Penny arrives in Sydney at $13{:}00$ and on $1 \text {st February}$.
</div>

**Question**

Roweena lives in St Albans and needs to arrive at St Pancras in order to catch the $0855$ train to Paris. 
There is a $30 \ \text{minute}$ check-in at St Pancras International station and she allows herself an extra
 $10 \ \text{minutes}$ 
to change platforms. 
Roweena knows that it takes her $25 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk from her house to get to the platform at St Albans station. 
What is the latest time that she needs to leave her house?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Roweena lives in St Albans and needs to arrive at St Pancras in order to catch the $0855$ train to Paris. 
There is a $30 \ \text{minute}$ check-in at St Pancras International station and she allows herself an extra
 $10 \ \text{minutes}$ 
to change platforms. 
Roweena knows that it takes her $25 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk from her house to get to the platform at St Albans station. 
What is the latest time that she needs to leave her house?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{Arrival time at  St Pancras International station }    & = 08{:}55 - 30 \ \text{min} - 10 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                             & = 08{:}15
\end{aligned}
$

Roweena should reach St Pancras with a train reaching before $08{:}15$.

The train reaching St Pancras  before $0815$ is the $08{:}12$ train, starting at St Albans at $07{:}44$. 

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{Latest time she needs to leave}              & = 07{:}44 - 25 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                   & = 07{:}19
\end{aligned}
$

The latest time that Roweena need to leave her house is $= 07{:}19$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$07{:}19$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If March $23 ^ \text{rd}$ is a Monday, on what day of the week is April $2 ^ \text{nd}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If March $23 ^ \text{rd}$ is a Monday, on what day of the week is April $2 ^ \text{nd}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \text {March} \ 23\text{rd} \ \text {Monday} + 7 \ \text {days} + 3 \ \text{days} \\\\
&= \text {March} \ 30\text{th} \ \text {Monday} + 3 \ \text {days} \\\\
&= \text {April} \ 2\text{nd} \ \text {Thursday}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text {Thursday}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A train leaves Stevenage at $0942$ and arrives in York at $1134$. How many **minutes** does the journey take?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A train leaves Stevenage at $0942$ and arrives in York at $1134$. How many **minutes** does the journey take?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken}           &= 11 {:} 34 - 09 {:} 42 \\\\
                            &= 1 \ \text {hour} \ 52 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                            &= 1 \times 60 \ \text {minutes} + \ 52 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                            &= 60 + 52 \\\\
                            &= 112  \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The opening hours of my local supermarket are $7 \ \text{am}$ to $9 \ \text{pm}$ Mondays to Saturdays and 
$10{:}30 \ \text{am}$ to $4{:}30 \ \text{pm}$ on Sundays. For how many hours does this supermarket open each week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The opening hours of my local supermarket are $7 \ \text{am}$ to $9 \ \text{pm}$ Mondays to Saturdays and 
$10{:}30 \ \text{am}$ to $4{:}30 \ \text{pm}$ on Sundays. For how many hours does this supermarket open each week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total hours}    &= 6 \times ( 9 \ \text{pm} - 7 \ \text{am} ) + (04{:}30 \ \text{pm} - 10{:}30 \ \text{am}) \\\\
                      &= 6 \times 14 \ \text{hours} +  6 \ \text{hours} \\\\
                      &= 84 + 6 \\\\
                      &= 90 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$90 \ \text {hours}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A concert performance of Mahler's third symphony begins at $7{:}35 \ \text{pm}$ and ends at 
$9{:}11 \ \text{pm}$. 
How many minutes does it last?
</code></pre>

                           &=60 + 36 \\\\
                           &= 96 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The Swiss transportation system is the best in the world. Not only does it run on time but it is possible to transfer seamlessly from one mode of transport to another.

The journey from Giessbach to Grutschalp has three stages: a steamer across Lake Brienzersee to Interlaken, a train from Interlaken to Lauterbrunnen and finally a cable car from Lauterbrunnen to Grutschalp.

-  Steamer boats leave Giessbach every $70 \ \text{minutes}$ and the journey across the lake takes $60 \ \text{minutes}$.
-  Trains leave Interlaken every $40 \ \text{minutes}$ and the journey takes $30 \ \text{minutes}$.  
-  Cable cars leave Lauterbrunnen every $15 \ \text{minutes}$ and the journey takes $10 \ \text{minutes}$.

The first steamer, train and cable car of the day are all at $07{:}00$.

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At a busy railway station trains leave from platform $5$ every $6 \ \text{minutes}$ and from platform $8$ every 
$10 \ \text{minutes}$. Trains leave from both platforms at $15{:}57$. When do trains next leave both platforms at the same time?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At a busy railway station trains leave from platform $5$ every $6 \ \text{minutes}$ and from platform $8$ every 
$10 \ \text{minutes}$. Trains leave from both platforms at $15{:}57$. When do trains next leave both platforms at the same time?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time trains leave both platforms simultaneously }     &= 15{:}57 + 30 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                                            &= 16{:}27 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$ 16{:}27 $

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many minutes are there from $11{:}11$ until $23{:}23$ on the same day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many minutes are there from $11{:}11$ until $23{:}23$ on the same day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Difference}     &= 23{:}23 - 11{:}11 \\\\
                      &= 12 \ \text{hours} \ 12 \ \text{minutes}   \\\\
                      &= 12 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 12 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                      &= 720 + 12 \\\\
                      &= 732  \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$732  \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                  &= 8 \ \text{hours} \ 15 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Nani flies directly to Athens from London, departing at $08{:}20 \ \text{hours}$. 
If the journey from London takes $3 \ \text{hours } 45 \ \text{minutes}$, at what time, local to Athens, will Nani arrive in Athens?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Nani flies directly to Athens from London, departing at $08{:}20 \ \text{hours}$. 
If the journey from London takes $3 \ \text{hours } 45 \ \text{minutes}$, at what time, local to Athens, will Nani arrive in Athens?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time to Athens}               &= 08{:}20 + 3 \ \text{hours } 45 \ \text{minutes} + 2 \ \text{hours } \\\\
                                    &= 08{:}20 + 5 \ \text{hours } 45 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                    &= 14{:}05
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$14{:}05$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

It takes the same time to fly from Athens to London as it takes from London to Athens.

Iani leaves Athens airport at $19{:}15 \ \text{hours}$.

At what time will she reach London (local time)?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                                    &= 19{:}15 + 1 \ \text{hour } 45 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                                    &= 21{:}00
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I arrived at the station at $7.47 \ \text{a.m}$. My train was due at five past eight but was $13 \ \text{minutes}$ late.

How long did I have to wait for my train?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I arrived at the station at $7.47 \ \text{a.m}$. My train was due at five past eight but was $13 \ \text{minutes}$ late.
<emptyline>
How long did I have to wait for my train?
</code></pre>
</div>

                    &= 8{:}18 \ \text{am} - 7{:}47 \ \text{am} \\\\
                    &= 31 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q18-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q18-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q18-i00.png")

Clock $A$ is $12 \ \text{minutes}$ fast.

How many minutes slow is clock $B$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>
How many minutes slow is clock $B$?
</code></pre>

                     &= 06{:}53 \\\\

                     &= 18 \ \text{minutes} 
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kyra parks her car at $10.30 \ \text{am}$. 
She collects the car at $2.15 \ \text{pm}$. 
How much does she have to pay?

| **Car Park Charge** |                  |
|:--------------------:|:----------------:|
|       **Time**       |    **Charge**    |
|     Up to $1$ hour     | $20  \text{p}$  |
|     $1$ to $2$ hours     |  $50  \text{p}$ |
|     $2$ to $3$ hours     | $\pounds  1.00$ |
|     $3$ to $4$ hours     | $\pounds  1.70$ |
|     Over $4$ hours     | $\pounds  5.00$ |


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>
</code></pre>

How long did she spend in a car?

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let total travelling time $= a$

Time spent travelling in a car $= \dfrac {a} {2}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{of} \ (a - \dfrac {a} {2})     &=  2 \\\\ 
\dfrac {1} {2} \times \ (\dfrac{a \times 2}{1 \times 2} - \dfrac {a} {2})     &=  2 \\\\ 
\dfrac {1} {2} \times \ (\dfrac{2a}{2} - \dfrac {a} {2})     &=  2 \\\\ 
\dfrac {1} {2} \times \ (\dfrac{2a - a} {2})     &=  2 \\\\ 
\dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {a} {2}                  &=  2 \\\\ 
\dfrac {a} {2 \times 2}                               &=  2 \\\\ 
\dfrac {a} {4}                                        &=  2 \\\\ 
a                                                     &= 2 \times 4 \\\\
a                                                     &= 8  \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total travelling time}                          &=  8  \ \text{hours} \\\\
\text{Time spent in a car}                            &=  \dfrac {a} {2} \\\\
                                                      &=  \dfrac {8} {2} \\\\
                                                      &= \dfrac {4 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                                      &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
                                                      &= 4 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$ 4 \ \text{hours}$

</div>
</div>

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q22-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q22-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q22-i00.png")

She puts it upside down on her bedside table.

The same time is shown.

show the same time when it is upside down as when it is the 
right way up?

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The instructions below are used to work out the cooking time for a turkey.

$50 \ \text{minutes per kilogram}$ plus $20 \ \text{minutes}$

Claire wants to cook a turkey with a mass of $2.5 \ \text{kilograms}$.

For how long should Claire cook the turkey?

*Give your answer in hours and minutes.*

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The instructions below are used to work out the cooking time for a turkey.
<emptyline>
$50 \ \text{minutes per kilogram}$ plus $20 \ \text{minutes}$
<emptyline>
Claire wants to cook a turkey with a mass of $2.5 \ \text{kilograms}$.
<emptyline>
For how long should Claire cook the turkey?
<emptyline>
*Give your answer in hours and minutes.*
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cooking Time}         &= 2.5 \times 50 \ \text {minutes} + 20 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                             &= 125 + 20 \\\\
                             &= 145 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                             &= 120 \ \text {minutes} + 25 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                             &= 2 \ \text {hours} \ 25 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2 \ \text {hours} \ 25 \ \text {minutes}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The school concert starts at $2{:}45 \ \text{p.m}$.

It lasts for $2 \ \text{hours}$ and $28 \ \text{minutes}$ and, in addition, there is an interval of $20 \ \text{minutes}$.

At what time does the concert end?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The school concert starts at $2{:}45 \ \text{p.m}$.
<emptyline>
It lasts for $2 \ \text{hours}$ and $28 \ \text{minutes}$ and, in addition, there is an interval of $20 \ \text{minutes}$.
<emptyline>
At what time does the concert end?
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
&= 2 {:} 45 \ \text {pm} + 2 \ \text {hours} \ 28 \ \text {minutes} + 20 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
&= 2 {:} 45 \ \text {pm} + 2 \ \text {hours} \ 48 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
&= 5 {:} 33 \ \text {pm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

The time in New York is $5 \ \text{hours}$ behind the time in London.

Bill's journey from New York to Sri Lanka takes exactly $30 \ \text{hours}$.

Bill leaves New York on Wednesday at $19{:}40$

On which day and at what time does Bill arrive in Sri Lanka?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The time in New York is $5 \ \text{hours}$ behind the time in London.
<emptyline>
Bill's journey from New York to Sri Lanka takes exactly $30 \ \text{hours}$.
<emptyline>
Bill leaves New York on Wednesday at $19{:}40$
<emptyline>
On which day and at what time does Bill arrive in Sri Lanka?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Time in Sri Lanka}  &= 19{:}40 + 30 \ \text{hours} +  4 \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{hours}+ 5 \ \text{hours} \\\\
                           &= 19{:}40 + 30 \ \text{hours} +   4 \ \text{hours} \ 30 \ \text{minutes} + 5 \ \text{hours} \\\\
                           &= 19{:}40 + 30 \ \text{hours} +   4 \ \text{hours} + 30 \ \text{minutes} + 5 \ \text{hours} \\\\
                           &= 19{:}40 + 39 \ \text{hours} +   30 \ \text{minutes}  \\\\
                           &= 19{:}40 + 1 \ \text{day} + 15 \ \text{hours} +   30 \ \text{minutes}  \\\\
                           &= 19{:}40  + 15 \ \text{hours} \ 30 \ \text{minutes}  \\\\
                           &= 11{:}10
\end{aligned}
$

Day Bill arrived Sri Lanka $= \text {Friday}$
</div>

**Question**

Katy is going to the cinema to see a film that starts at $3.25 \ \text{pm}$ and lasts $108 \ \text{minutes}$.

At what time will the film end?

Write your answer using the $24{-}\text{hour}$ clock.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>
Write your answer using the $24{-}\text{hour}$ clock.
</code></pre>
</div>

                       &= 15{:}25 + 108 \ \text{minutes} \\\\

                       &= 17{:}13
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

|:---------:|:-----------------------:|:-----------------------:|

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                          &= 3 \times 11 \\\\
                          &= 33 \ \text{miles}
\end{aligned}
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Average Speed of express train}   &= \dfrac {\text{Distance between Andforth and Ermston}}  {\text{Time taken to travel from Andforth to Ermston}} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {33}  {14{:}02 - 13{:}18} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {33}  {14{:}02 - 13{:}18} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {33}  { \dfrac {44} {60} } \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {33 \times 60 }  {44} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {3 \times 11 \times 4 \times 15 }  {4 \times 11} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel{11} \times \cancel 4 \times 15 }  {\cancel 4 \times \cancel{11}} \\\\
                       &= 3 \times 15 \\\\
                       &= 45 \ \text{miles per hour}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Neil is allowed to watch three hours of TV each day in the holidays. 
He watches cartoons from $6{:}20 \ \text{pm}$ to $7{:}10 \ \text{pm}$ and a 
sports programme from $7{:}25 \ \text{pm}$ to $9{:}00 \ \text{pm}$. 

For how much longer could he have watched TV without breaking his rule?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Neil is allowed to watch three hours of TV each day in the holidays. 
He watches cartoons from $6{:}20 \ \text{pm}$ to $7{:}10 \ \text{pm}$ and a 
sports programme from $7{:}25 \ \text{pm}$ to $9{:}00 \ \text{pm}$. 
<emptyline>
For how much longer could he have watched TV without breaking his rule?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total time spent}     &= 7{:}10  - 6{:}20 + 9{:}00 -7{:}25 \\\\
                            &= 50 \ \text{minutes} + 1 \ \text{hour} \ 35 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                            &= 2 \ \text{hours} \ 25 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time left}            &= 3 \ \text{hours} - 2 \ \text{hours} \ 25 \ \text{minutes}  \\\\
                            &= 35 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$35 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

My digital watch is set to show time according to the $24$ hour clock. It is currently showing $21{:}10$. How long will it be until it next shows a time with the digits $2, 1, 1$ and $0$ but in any order?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">My digital watch is set to show time according to the $24$ hour clock. It is currently showing $21{:}10$. How long will it be until it next shows a time with the digits $2, 1, 1$ and $0$ but in any order?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$21{:}10$

Following digits are needed $0, 1, 1$ and $2$

With $2100$ hours no other combination is impossible

With $2200$ hours no combination is possible

With $2300$ hours no combination is possible

With $0000$ hours no combination is possible

With $0100$ hours it's possible as it already has $0$ and $1$

Next time all the four digits $(0, 1, 1, 1)$ shows together is when it is 

$01{:}12$ hours

Let's find how long it will take from $21{:}10$ to $01{:}12$

$01{:}12 - 21{:}10 =4\ \text{hrs} \ 2 \ \text{min}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

%empty%

Next time all the four digits $(0, 1, 1, 1)$ shows together is when it is 

$01{:}12$ hours

Let's find how long it will take from $21{:}10$ to $01{:}12$

$01{:}12 - 21{:}10 =4\ \text{hrs} \ 2 \ \text{min}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4\ \text{hrs} \ 2 \ \text{min}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alison watches two quiz programmes on TV. The first 
is on from $6{:}35 \ \text{pm}$ until $7{:}15 \ \text{pm}$, the 
second lasts for half an hour. Later on, she watches 
a film from $9{:}30 \ \text{pm}$ until $11{:}25 \ \text{pm}$. In 
hours and minutes, how long has she spent watching TV?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alison watches two quiz programmes on TV. The first 
is on from $6{:}35 \ \text{pm}$ until $7{:}15 \ \text{pm}$, the 
second lasts for half an hour. Later on, she watches 
a film from $9{:}30 \ \text{pm}$ until $11{:}25 \ \text{pm}$. In 
hours and minutes, how long has she spent watching TV?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

\begin{aligned}

                            &= 40 + 30 + 60 + 55 \\\\
                            &= 185 \ \text{minutes} 
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

I calculate on another occasion that the turkey I have bought will take $3\, \text{hours}$ to cook. How heavy is this turkey?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I calculate on another occasion that the turkey I have bought will take $3\, \text{hours}$ to cook. How heavy is this turkey?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of the turkey $= w$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
25 \times w + 30                    &= 3 \times 60 \\\\
25w + 30                            &= 180 \\\\
25w                                 &= 180 - 30 \\\\
25w                                 &= 150 \\\\
w                                   &= \dfrac {150} {25} \\\\
w                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times 6} {25} \\\\
w                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {25} \times 6} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
w                                   &= 6 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$6 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Frank catches the $7{:}52$ train from Cambridge to Northampton and he arrives in Northampton at $9{:}21$. How long was is journey? Give your answer in hours and minutes.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Frank catches the $7{:}52$ train from Cambridge to Northampton and he arrives in Northampton at $9{:}21$. How long was is journey? Give your answer in hours and minutes.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Duration} &= 9{:}21 - 7{:}52 \\\\
                 &= 1 \ \text {hour} \ 29 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

&= 3 \ \text {hours } 43 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

From there it takes $8\, \text{minutes}$ to walk to John's house. I want to be at John's house by $2.00 \,\text{pm}$

| Main Road        | $13.02$     | $13.24$     | $13.42$     | $13.56$     |
| London Road      | $13.14$     | $13.36$     | $13.54$     | $14.08$     |

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A train leaves Manchester and arrives in London at $13{:}37$ 

What time did the train depart Manchester if the total journey time was $173$ $\text{minutes}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A train leaves Manchester and arrives in London at $13{:}37$ 
<emptyline>
What time did the train depart Manchester if the total journey time was $173$ $\text{minutes}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Departure time} &= 13{:}37 - 173 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                       &= 13{:}37 - 2 \ \text {hours } 53 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                       &= 10{:}44
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10{:}44$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A plane leaves London Airport at $16{:}30$ and takes $5\dfrac {3} {4}\ \text{hours}$ on its journey. At what time does it arrive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A plane leaves London Airport at $16{:}30$ and takes $5\dfrac {3} {4}\ \text{hours}$ on its journey. At what time does it arrive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Arrival time} &= 16{:}30 + 5 \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text {hours} \\\\
                     &= 16{:}30 + 5 \ \text {hours } 45 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
                     &= 22{:}15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
